component.name: WebApp Manager
component.summary: Create web app launchers with dedicated browser profiles

description.p: WebApp Manager turns a website into a proper desktop or mobile application: a launcher in the application menu, its own icon, and a browser profile that belongs to that app alone, separate from everyday browsing.
Each web app can be configured individually:

ul.li: Firefox, Chrome or Chromium as the underlying engine
Window mode per form factor, so the same app can open kiosk-style on a phone and windowed on a desktop
Privacy and cleanup options, such as clearing cache or cookies on exit
Custom CSS and JavaScript injected into the site
Import and export of web apps as .wapp files

description.p: Browsers, launchers and profiles live on the host system, so the web apps created here work exactly like natively installed applications.
Adds a Flatpak package. Browser detection and launching are routed to the host so the sandboxed build behaves like the native one.
